meta.title: Stone Chen, Frontend Engineer · Tech Lead
meta.description: Frontend engineer turned product-minded tech lead. CUBE online banking at Cathay United Bank, now medical AI at the CSMUH AI Center.

work.title: Three projects that show how I work.

items.title: Of 400 features, keeping the two that earn the most rock-solid.
items.desc: Led the fund and FX modules of a million-user online bank: top 10 by traffic, 93% of revenue. Shipped every month under banking regulation without trading speed for quality.

items.title: Turning what physicians asked for into a system live within a month.
items.desc: As TPM, translated clinical needs into specs with clinicians, data analysts and engineers. Report time down 60%; physicians save about 20% of their day.

items.title: Getting a codebase to the point where AI can safely take the wheel.
items.desc: aic-fe-infra, shared frontend dev infrastructure: PR checks, automated upgrades and AI agent rules and skills maintained in one place and rolled out by a version bump. Plus a spec-first development skill, mock server, an n8n team knowledge base and a Claude Design System: what AI writes has a spec to match and a gate to pass.

items.title: Spec first
items.desc: Spec and demo agreed before build, API contracts before frontend, mock server before backend.

items.title: Leading a team of 5–8
items.desc: Standups, an onboarding handbook, a component library and Storybook so new joiners ship in week one.

items.title: AI-assisted development
items.desc: AI in review, layout and the knowledge base, not just in writing code.

items.title: Performance and quality
items.desc: Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and the caution you learn from being on call.

side.title: Still trying new things after hours.
